pkgmetadata.longdescription: WinBoat runs a Windows virtual machine inside a container and exposes the guest's applications as regular windows on the Linux desktop via FreeRDP RemoteApp, alongside filesystem and USB device sharing.

use.flag: Use app-containers/docker as the container runtime.
Use app-containers/podman as the container runtime. Note that USB passthrough is not supported on Podman.
Build against net-misc/freerdp with smartcard support, allowing host smartcards to be shared with the Windows guest.
